title: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 with Cross Region Inferencing
independent_reason: Managed cross-region routing takes over multi-region capacity routing for Grok inference.
reason: Bedrock explicitly assumes capacity routing across multiple regions, supporting a different deployment for workloads that previously managed model capacity region by region.

title: Savings Plans and Reserved Instances Group Sharing is now generally available
independent_reason: Finance teams assign shared discount benefits to account groups.
reason: Savings Plans and Reserved Instances Group Sharing is now generally available

title: Database Insights provides on-demand analysis for RDS MySQL and RDS MariaDB
independent_reason: MySQL and MariaDB operators gain automated bottleneck diagnosis.
reason: Workflow change for RDS MySQL and MariaDB diagnostics — Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights expands the availability of its on-demand analysis experience to the RDS for MySQL and RDS for MariaDB database engines.

title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports retryable writes
independent_reason: Driver retries transient writes without application intervention.
reason: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports retryable writes starting with engine version 8.0.2, eliminating the need for additional code changes when enabling this capability.

title: AgentCore payments is now generally available in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
independent_reason: Transacting agents can delegate settlement across external wallets to AgentCore.
reason: AgentCore orchestrates microtransactions between agent tools and external wallets, establishing an infrastructure-enforced payment path.

title: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now supports creating Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs
independent_reason: Multi-AZ storage can now run in a participant account's shared VPC.
reason: Multi-AZ storage can now reside inside centrally owned shared subnets instead of requiring a participant-owned VPC.

title: Nested virtualization is now available on additional Intel platforms and AWS GovCloud (US) regions
independent_reason: Nested virtualization gains supported instance types and regions.
reason: Nested virtualization is now available on additional Intel platforms and AWS GovCloud (US) regions

title: Amazon DynamoDB now supports real-time vector search
independent_reason: Vectors can be indexed alongside transactional data in DynamoDB.
reason: Embeddings and their searchable vector index can reside alongside application data in DynamoDB.

title: AgentCore runtime instances are now generally available
independent_reason: Agents can deploy on managed dedicated EC2 capacity instead of microVMs.
reason: Agents can run on customer-account EC2 capacity under managed runtime operations.

title: AWS HealthOmics now supports automatic detection of WDL workflow parameters
independent_reason: WDL authors no longer create parameter templates manually.
reason: Workflow change for WDL workflow setup — Today, AWS HealthOmics announces automatic parameter interpolation for Workflow Description Language (WDL) workflows to help streamline the workflow creation process.

title: CloudTrail Lake now supports event enrichment and expanded event size
independent_reason: Auditors can enrich event records with tags and contextual keys.
reason: CloudTrail can attach contextual tags and keys at event capture, enabling a new step in creating application-specific reports.

title: GLM 5.3 by Z.ai is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
independent_reason: GLM is an additional model choice for Bedrock inference.
reason: Amazon Bedrock now supports GLM 5.3 from Z.ai, giving you a powerful new option for agentic coding and long-horizon software engineering work.

title: Accelerate infrastructure development with AWS CloudFormation intelligent authoring in IDEs
independent_reason: IDE validation brings deployment checks into the authoring step.
reason: Workflow change for IDE-based infrastructure authoring — Today, AWS CloudFormation announces the launch of the AWS CloudFormation Language Server, a new capability that brings intelligent authoring, early validation, troubleshooting, and drift management directly into Integrated Development Environment (IDE) through the AWS Toolkit .

title: Amazon S3 Object Lock now supports variable retention with event holds
independent_reason: An event release starts a timed retention period for S3 objects.
reason: Amazon S3 Object Lock now supports variable retention, allowing you to apply write-once-read-many (WORM) protection to objects whose required retention period starts with a future event, such as a contract closing or an audit completing.

title: Amazon S3 Express One Zone now supports S3 Inventory
independent_reason: Scheduled inventory replaces synchronous listing for directory-bucket reporting.
reason: Amazon S3 Express One Zone, a high-performance S3 storage class for latency-sensitive applications, now supports S3 Inventory.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports the Agent Toolkit for AWS with a curated skill
independent_reason: Coding agents can now invoke domain management actions directly.
reason: Workflow change for agent-driven OpenSearch administration — Amazon OpenSearch Service now integrates with the Agent Toolkit for AWS , enabling you to build, manage, and query OpenSearch Service domains and OpenSearch Serverless collections directly from AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Kiro, and Cursor.

title: Introducing agentic capabilities for Amazon Q Developer Chat in the AWS Management Console and chat applications
independent_reason: Multi-step investigations are delegated to Q within chat.
reason: Workflow change for console troubleshooting — Today, we’re announcing new and improved agentic Amazon Q Developer experience in the AWS Management Console, Microsoft Teams, and Slack.

title: Amazon Aurora serverless now supports up to 384 ACUs
independent_reason: The Aurora serverless capacity ceiling rises to 384 ACUs.
reason: Local change for large Aurora clusters — Amazon Aurora serverless now supports database capacity of up to 384 Aurora Capacity Units (ACUs) for Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition, a 50% increase from the previous maximum of 256 ACUs.

title: Announcing general availability of Amazon EC2 M4 Max Mac instances
independent_reason: Mac builders gain a higher-performance EC2 instance option.
reason: Announcing general availability of Amazon EC2 M4 Max Mac instances

title: AWS KMS adds support for post-quantum ML-DSA digital signatures
independent_reason: Existing KMS signing APIs accept another signing algorithm.
reason: AWS KMS adds support for post-quantum ML-DSA digital signatures

title: AWS Database Migration Service now supports Multi-ENI networking for homogeneous migrations.
independent_reason: DMS homogeneous migrations can use private per-migration network interfaces.
reason: A migration gets its own interface address and can reach databases over peering, VPN or Direct Connect.

title: AWS Secrets Manager announces support for cost allocation tags for secrets
independent_reason: Teams can allocate secret costs using per-secret tags.
reason: Workflow change for secret cost allocation — AWS Secrets Manager now enables customers to allocate and track cost for their secret usage.

title: Amazon DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region strong consistency now supports application resiliency testing with AWS Fault Injection Service
independent_reason: Global table operators can run controlled regional failure experiments.
reason: Workflow change for testing global table resilience — Amazon DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region strong consistency (MRSC) now supports application resiliency testing with AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS), a fully managed service for running controlled fault injection experiments to improve application performance, observability, and resilience.

title: AWS Step Functions now supports Service Quotas
independent_reason: Operators can track Step Functions quotas and monitor utilization centrally.
reason: With this launch, you can now view your AWS Step Functions account-level quota values through the Service Quotas console and monitor quota utilization through Amazon CloudWatch metrics.

title: Amazon Cognito now supports self-service provisioned API rate limits
independent_reason: Self-service adjustments remove the manual quota review step.
reason: Amazon Cognito now allows you to increase or decrease your provisioned API rate limits on demand.

title: Amazon GameLift Streams introduces secure terminal access for stream sessions
independent_reason: Operators can start a secure shell scoped to a live stream session.
reason: Amazon GameLift Streams introduces secure terminal access for stream sessions

title: Amazon EC2 announces Managed resource visibility settings
independent_reason: A visibility setting filters managed resources from EC2 listings.
reason: Local change for EC2 console resource visibility — Amazon EC2 now lets you control whether resources provisioned by managed instance offerings appear in your Amazon EC2 console views and API list operations.

title: Amazon ECR now supports PrivateLink for FIPS Endpoints
independent_reason: FIPS-validated registry requests can use a private VPC endpoint.
reason: PrivateLink makes a private VPC-to-ECR path available for FIPS-validated connections.

title: Amazon S3 Lifecycle pauses actions on objects that are unable to replicate
independent_reason: Expiration and transition pause automatically when replication fails.
reason: Once you have corrected your replication configuration or permissions, you can use S3 Batch Replication to replicate objects that previously failed.

title: AWS HealthOmics now supports ephemeral storage for private workflows
independent_reason: Workflow tasks can isolate scratch I/O onto a dedicated local volume.
reason: Tasks can direct temporary reads and writes to dedicated local volumes, separate from shared run storage.

title: AWS DMS Schema Conversion introduces Virtual Mode
independent_reason: Schema conversion planning can run without provisioning a target database.
reason: Offline planning no longer needs a live target database.

title: AWS KMS launches on-demand key rotation for imported keys
independent_reason: Imported keys can be rotated in place while preserving their identifiers.
reason: This new capability enables you to rotate the cryptographic key material of Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) keys without changing the key identifier (key ARN).

title: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases supports GraphRAG now generally available
independent_reason: A managed retrieval pipeline combines Neptune graph traversal and vector search.
reason: A managed knowledge base builds and stores the embedding and entity graph in Neptune Analytics.

title: Amazon ElastiCache now supports Graviton4-based M8g, R8g, and C8gn nodes
independent_reason: Existing cache workloads can select new node families.
reason: Graviton4-based nodes provide up to 47% higher throughput, up to 43% lower P99 latency, and up to 31% better price-performance for on-demand pricing over Graviton3-based nodes of equivalent sizes on Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey, depending on node family, size, and workload configuration.

title: AWS Batch now supports Amazon EKS access entry authentication
independent_reason: AWS Batch automatically creates and configures cluster access entries.
reason: Batch creates and associates cluster access entries automatically when the operator enables the setting.

title: Amazon SageMaker contributes a custom transport to OpenLineage community and offers additional lineage capabilities
independent_reason: Lineage events are captured and delivered to the studio automatically.
reason: AWS announces that Amazon SageMaker has contributed a custom transport ‘ AmazonDataZoneTransport ’ to the OpenLineage community and enhanced automated lineage capabilities.

title: Amazon Neptune announces dual stack support with IPv6
independent_reason: Existing clients can connect with a second protocol without changing applications.
reason: Amazon Neptune now supports dual-stack mode, enabling database clusters to accept connections over IPv4, IPv6, or both protocols simultaneously.

title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports partial indexes
independent_reason: An index predicate narrows indexed rows in existing table queries.
reason: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports partial indexes

title: Amazon Q Developer plugin for CloudZero is now generally available
independent_reason: Operators can ask Q for CloudZero data without switching consoles.
reason: Amazon Q Developer plugin for CloudZero is now generally available

title: AWS Config now supports internal service linked rules
independent_reason: Service-managed rules can deliver results independently of customer-managed recorders.
reason: Service-linked rules deliver results directly to the consuming security service, independently of customer-managed recorders.

title: AWS Compute Optimizer now supports idle recommendations for six additional resource types
independent_reason: Existing idle-resource detection reaches six more resource types.
reason: AWS Compute Optimizer now supports idle recommendations for six additional resource types

title: AWS Clean Rooms Spark SQL now supports aggregation and list analysis rules
independent_reason: Spark SQL analyses gain additional policy options.
reason: Partners can update an existing collaboration to use Spark, removing the previous requirement to create another collaboration.

title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations is now generally available
independent_reason: Production agent tests and quality assessments can run continuously.
reason: Evaluations enables developers to monitor agent quality through continuous evaluation of production traffic, validate changes through testing workflows, and measure agent performance against defined expectations.

title: Announcing the AWS Marketplace and Amazon Business unified storefront
independent_reason: Two procurement catalogs and their approval flows can be consolidated.
reason: A unified storefront consolidates catalog curation and approval rules across the two purchasing systems.

title: Amazon QuickSight now supports connectivity to Apache Impala
independent_reason: QuickSight gains a native data path from Impala into SPICE.
reason: The new native connector establishes a direct Impala-to-SPICE ingestion path.

title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds light mode support for IAM-based domains
independent_reason: Authors can select a different interface color scheme.
reason: Local change for Studio interface preferences — Today, AWS announces light mode support in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio for IAM-based domains.

title: AWS Outposts racks now support LagStatus CloudWatch metric
independent_reason: LAG monitoring in CloudWatch can dispense with an external networking tool.
reason: For LAG-status monitoring, CloudWatch can replace the external network monitoring tool previously needed to observe that signal.

title: Amazon Quick Suite Enables Easy Resolution of Ambiguous Map Locations
independent_reason: Map authors can disambiguate locations in a visual.
reason: Quick Sight in Amazon Quick Suite now enables authors to resolve or update ambiguous locations directly on map visuals for accurate geographical data visualization.

title: Amazon Bedrock Custom Model Import now supports OpenAI GPT OSS models
independent_reason: GPT OSS users can move custom model serving onto managed infrastructure.
reason: Bedrock can serve the imported weights directly, eliminating customer-operated model serving for affected deployments.

title: AWS Managed Microsoft AD is now available on Windows functional level 2016
independent_reason: The directory functional level upgrades automatically in place.
reason: Local change for managed AD domains — Starting today, all AWS Directory Service for Microsoft AD (AWS Managed Microsoft AD) directories run on Windows functional level 2016.

title: Amazon CloudWatch launches unified management and analytics for operational, security, and compliance data
independent_reason: Customers can consolidate separate data stores and ETL pipelines.
reason: A unified data store and analytics layer can replace separate observability stores and ETL pipelines.

title: Amazon Nova now supports the customization of content moderation settings
independent_reason: Approved Nova workloads can tune moderation settings.
reason: Local change for Nova moderation policy — Amazon Nova models now support the customization of content moderation settings for approved business use cases that require processing or generating sensitive content.

title: Amazon MQ now supports HTTP based authentication for RabbitMQ brokers
independent_reason: Brokers can delegate identity checks to an HTTP server.
reason: The broker can delegate authentication and authorization checks to an HTTP server, changing the identity-check path.

title: AWS End User Messaging now supports CloudFormation for SMS
independent_reason: SMS resources can be provisioned through reusable deployment templates.
reason: AWS End User Messaging now supports CloudFormation for SMS

title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports Zstandard (zstd) codec for index compression
independent_reason: Customers can choose another index compression codec.
reason: With this launch, customers can configure Zstandard compression to achieve up to 32% reduction in index size compared to the default LZ4 codec, helping lower managed storage costs for data-intensive workloads.

title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk launches Deployments tab with in-progress deployment logs
independent_reason: Deployment logs are visible during rollout without manual event correlation.
reason: Workflow change for deployment monitoring — AWS Elastic Beanstalk now provides a Deployments tab in the environment dashboard, giving customers a consolidated view of their deployment history and real-time deployment progress with step-by-step deployment logs.

title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds Observability for AWS Glue jobs via CloudWatch metrics
independent_reason: Job metrics and logs can be correlated in one troubleshooting view.
reason: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds Observability for jobs, it now displays Amazon CloudWatch metrics for AWS Glue jobs directly alongside job logs in a single, unified interface.

title: Amazon ECS Service Connect now supports Zone-Aware routing
independent_reason: Service traffic can preferentially route to same-zone endpoints.
reason: Built-in routing prefers local healthy endpoints and adjusts weights in the same deployed service topology, with no additional infrastructure or application logic.

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service announces Derived Source for storage optimization
independent_reason: A configurable index option stores less data for equivalent searches.
reason: Amazon OpenSearch Service announces Derived Source for storage optimization

title: AWS Budgets now supports Billing View for cross-account cost monitoring
independent_reason: Budget owners can monitor cross-account spend without management-account access.
reason: AWS Budgets now supports Billing View for cross-account cost monitoring

title: CloudWatch provides execution plan capture for Aurora PostgreSQL
independent_reason: Query plans are captured and retained automatically for later diagnosis.
reason: Workflow change for Aurora PostgreSQL query diagnostics — Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights now collects the query execution plans of top SQL queries running on Aurora PostgreSQL instances, and stores them over time.

title: Customer Carbon Footprint Tool has new features and an updated methodology
independent_reason: Teams can export monthly carbon data through Billing Data Exports.
reason: You can now export your monthly data through AWS's Billing and Cost Management Data Exports service.

title: Amazon Quick announces autonomous agents, multi-dataset analytics, and redesigned activity feed
independent_reason: Recurring analysis tasks can run autonomously.
reason: Agents operate continuously to automate workflows like following up on stalled deals, summarizing regulatory changes, and processing purchase orders, eliminating manual repetitive work and notification overload.

title: AWS Partner Central now supports deal sizing using total contract value (TCV)
independent_reason: TCV submission removes manual monthly revenue estimation.
reason: Partner Central converts contract value and duration into recurring revenue, removing a manual forecasting step.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano now available on Amazon Bedrock
independent_reason: Bedrock customers can choose an additional model.
reason: Amazon Bedrock now supports NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B model, NVIDIA's latest breakthrough in efficient language modeling that delivers high reasoning performance, native tool calling support, and extended context processing with 256k token context window.

title: SageMaker JumpStart now offers optimized deployments for foundation models
independent_reason: Preconfigured deployment profiles reduce manual performance tuning.
reason: SageMaker JumpStart now offers optimized deployments for foundation models

title: Announcing MQTT enabled SiteWise Edge gateways for AWS IoT SiteWise
independent_reason: Edge gateways gain an integrated broker linking custom edge components.
reason: An MQTT broker on the edge gateway replaces individual point-to-point component connections.

title: CloudWatch RUM now supports JavaScript source maps for easier error debugging
independent_reason: Debuggers can map minified stack traces directly to source locations.
reason: Amazon CloudWatch RUM, which helps developers monitor real user interactions and diagnose front-end performance issues in web applications, now supports JavaScript source maps, enabling developers to convert minified JavaScript errors in the stack trace into readable formats for faster error resolution.

title: Amazon Lex launches support for Confirmation and Alphanumeric slot types for Korean
independent_reason: Built-in Korean slots remove manual synonym definition.
reason: Built-in confirmation slots normalize Korean synonyms that developers previously encoded in custom slots.

title: AWS Resource Explorer supports 47 additional resource types
independent_reason: Resource searches cover more types with the same operation.
reason: AWS Resource Explorer now supports 47 more resource types services including Amazon Bedrock, AWS Shield, and AWS Glue.

title: Amazon EventBridge now supports Customer Managed Keys (CMK) in API destinations connections
independent_reason: Customers can select their own encryption key for API destination credentials.
reason: Amazon EventBridge now supports Customer Managed Keys (CMK) in API destinations connections

title: Amazon MSK Replicator now supports enhanced consumer offset synchronization for bidirectional replication
independent_reason: Kafka applications can move independently without coordinating offset alignment.
reason: Amazon MSK Replicator now provides enhanced consumer offset synchronization for bidirectional replication, enabling applications to resume processing from the correct position when moving across Kafka clusters.

title: AWS Lambda announces native support for Avro and Protobuf formatted Kafka events
independent_reason: Kafka handlers can delegate schema validation and event decoding.
reason: Workflow change for processing Kafka events — AWS Lambda now provides native support for Avro and Protobuf formatted Kafka events with Apache Kafka’s event-source-mapping (ESM), and integrates with AWS Glue Schema registry (GSR), Confluent Cloud Schema registry (CCSR), and self-managed Confluent Schema registry (SCSR) for schema management.

title: Amazon Route 53 Resolver now supports AWS PrivateLink
independent_reason: Resolver management traffic can stay on a private network path.
reason: PrivateLink carries control-plane operations inside the AWS network in place of public API access.

title: AWS Network Firewall now supports Route 53 Resolved IP Validation
independent_reason: Firewall rules can validate destination IPs against actual DNS answers.
reason: Workflow change for firewall DNS validation — AWS Network Firewall now supports IP validation, extending domain-based filtering beyond HTTP/HTTPS to protocols such as SFTP and SSH.

title: Application Load Balancer now supports client credential flow with JWT verification
independent_reason: A load balancer can take over token validation from application code.
reason: JWT verification moves from application code into a shared load-balancer layer.

title: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports timestamp-based stream processing
independent_reason: Stream consumers can start at a chosen timestamp.
reason: Workflow change for replaying DynamoDB streams — Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports timestamp-based stream processing, enabling you to begin reading stream records from a specific point in time.

title: Amazon VPC adds CloudTrail logging for VPC resources created by default
independent_reason: Audit logs replace manual inventories of default VPC resources.
reason: Workflow change for VPC audit events — Amazon VPC has enhanced CloudTrail logging to include VPC resources created by default during a VPC creation.

title: Amazon CloudWatch now supports cross-account metrics centralization
independent_reason: Cross-account metrics can be replicated into a central destination account.
reason: Metrics replicate from multiple accounts and regions to one destination account.

title: AWS PCS now supports custom GRES, hardware topology, and MIG
independent_reason: Slurm clusters can schedule independently partitioned GPU slices.
reason: Administrators can partition GPUs into independently scheduled slices and let PCS discover their hardware topology.
